description:
Collection node, data-only — see `TableHeader`. Read by `Table` to build a row in the
table's collection; never rendered directly.

children.description:
`TableCell` elements, or a render function called once per column with that column's key —
required when the row's parent `TableBody` uses the `items`/render-function form.
children.name: children

type.name: ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>>[] | ((columnKey: Key) => ReactElement<...>)

className.description: A string of all className you want applied to the row.
className.name: className

textValue.description: A string representation of the row's contents, used for typeahead.
textValue.name: textValue
